subject: Genetics
title: The Ghost in Your Genes
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Ghost in Your Genes.

hook.text: Identical twins share 100% of their DNA. Yet one gets cancer and the other doesn't. Something beyond genes is at work.

buildup.text: Every cell in your body has the same DNA. But a brain cell acts nothing like a skin cell.

discovery.text: Epigenetics—marks above the genome—tell genes when to turn on and off. Same script, different performance in every cell.

climax.text: Your DNA is the hardware. Epigenetics is the software deciding which programs run.

punchline.text: Same genome. Different instructions. Different fate.

quiz.question: What do epigenetic marks control?
options: Which genes are turned on or off
